terms.definition: The complete NEXT F website management ecosystem.
The authoritative collection of versioned NEXT F contract definitions and metadata.
The web interface at contract.nextf.lk that presents the registry.
The business customer tenant that owns one or more Sites.
A customer website integrated with NEXT F website contracts.
The customer-facing CMS context for managing one Site.
A technical execution target such as preview, staging or production.
A major functional area composed of contracts, permissions, events and capabilities.
A smaller feature within a Module that may be independently enabled when supported.
A machine-readable structural definition of data and validation requirements.
A modeled business or platform concept with identity and lifecycle.
A stored instance of an Entity or Custom Collection definition.
A single typed property within a Schema.
A reusable group of Fields referenced by multiple Schemas.
A structured content unit rendered by a developer-controlled component.
A schema intended for customer-managed website content.
A machine-readable declaration of contract version, modules and capabilities.
The authoritative Manifest for one customer Site.
A versioned authoritative definition of data, behavior, events, permissions or interfaces.
The semantic version of a contract or coordinated registry release.
The version of an HTTP or programmatic API surface.
A standardized statement that something has happened.
An outbound HTTP delivery mechanism for a supported Event.
A stable identifier granting an action on a resource or domain.
A named collection of Permissions.
A configured connection between NEXT F capabilities and an external system.
The reusable implementation contract for a category or provider integration.
Published Site data explicitly allowed for unauthenticated delivery.
A person authorized to access Organization or Site workspaces.
A buyer or account holder interacting with an ecommerce Site.
